purpose: Remove only colored checkerboard fringe in the four small gaps between the navy/cyan logo outline and cream slogan ribbon.

method.channels_changed: alpha only; every RGB byte is identical to input, including newly transparent pixels
method.alpha_multiplier: clamp((max(R,G,B)-min(R,G,B)-85)/25,0,1); applied only within the four rectangles and candidate bounds
method.protection: Dark navy with mean RGB <85 and bright cream with mean RGB >=215 remain untouched; saturated cyan/yellow edges remain untouched. All pixels outside the four rectangles unchanged.

visual_review.evidence: Actually viewed all four 8x before/after notch crops and full-size navy and cream composites; reduced gray flecks without cutting into solid cyan/navy outlines or bright cream ribbon. Light-blue notch composites also viewed.
visual_review.scope_limit: Asset cleanup only; browser composition and engine integration are separate.
